rules.title: API null handling not specified
rules.description: Check explicit parameter required/null handling in a local OpenAPI contract; implementation remains unverified.
rules.remediation: Define required and nullable input behavior and invalid-null responses.

rules.title: API input type not specified
rules.description: Check that input schemas define their types. This does not validate runtime code.
rules.remediation: Define supported input types and reject incompatible values.

rules.title: API string length bounds not specified
rules.description: Check string minLength/maxLength constraints in the selected API contract.
rules.remediation: Set appropriate minimum and maximum lengths for string inputs.

rules.title: API numeric bounds not specified
rules.description: Check numeric lower and upper bounds in the selected API contract.
rules.remediation: Define valid numeric ranges, including any exclusive bounds.

rules.title: API invalid-parameter response not specified
rules.description: Check whether 400/422/4XX responses document invalid input handling.
rules.remediation: Document a stable response for invalid parameters and test the implementation separately.

rules.title: API authorization needs review
rules.description: Check the operation's declared security requirement and scheme. Object-level authorization cannot be proved by this check.
rules.remediation: Document applicable authentication and object/operation authorization; manually confirm intentionally public operations.

rules.title: API error disclosure needs review
rules.description: Check explicit error response schemas for diagnostic fields. Actual runtime output remains unverified.
rules.remediation: Use a bounded public error schema without stack traces or internal diagnostic fields.

rules.title: Authentication requirement not described
rules.description: Check whether selected SDD artifacts mention authentication for an identified API or sensitive operation. Missing text is a requirement gap, not a confirmed vulnerability.
rules.remediation: Describe the applicable authentication mechanism and its security acceptance criteria.

rules.title: Authorization requirement not described
rules.description: Check for authorization requirements around an identified API or sensitive operation.
rules.remediation: Define who may perform the operation and how object ownership or permissions are checked.

rules.title: Input constraints not described
rules.description: Check for both input type and string length requirements in selected SDD artifacts.
rules.remediation: Define input types, lengths and relevant bounds, including invalid-input handling.

rules.title: Sensitive data handling not described
rules.description: Check whether selected SDD artifacts address sensitive data or credential handling.
rules.remediation: Describe secret storage, redaction and protection of sensitive input, output and logs.

rules.title: Safe error handling not described
rules.description: Check whether public error handling is described for the identified operation.
rules.remediation: Define stable public errors and keep sensitive diagnostic details out of responses.

rules.title: Security acceptance criteria not described
rules.description: Check whether selected artifacts explicitly describe security acceptance criteria.
rules.remediation: Add security acceptance criteria for the operation's relevant controls and failure cases.

rules.title: Potential unsafe HTML output
rules.description: Dynamic text appears to reach an explicit HTML output sink. Context and sanitization require human review; this is not proof of XSS.
rules.remediation: Prefer text output or context-appropriate escaping. Review any deliberate HTML sanitization before rendering dynamic markup.

rules.title: Potential unsafe security configuration
rules.description: A listed security-sensitive setting has a plainly unsafe literal value. Runtime context and compensating controls are not inferred.
rules.remediation: Enable certificate verification and HttpOnly cookie protection. Remove insecure mode from production configuration and confirm the intended environment.

rules.title: Potential SQL string interpolation
rules.description: Interpolated SQL appears near a query or execute call in a bounded text window. This does not prove SQL injection or trace data across functions.
rules.remediation: Use parameterized queries and separate bound values. Validate identifiers using a fixed allowlist when parameters cannot represent them.

rules.title: Potential shell command interpolation
rules.description: A shell command appears to contain interpolated text. Literal commands and direct argument-array APIs are outside this heuristic.
rules.remediation: Avoid a shell; invoke a fixed executable with separate arguments and validate arguments against the operation's intended inputs.

rules.title: Potential hardcoded secret
rules.description: A credential-like name has a non-placeholder string literal. This heuristic does not prove the value is a live credential.
rules.remediation: Read credentials from a secure configuration or secret management mechanism. Confirm validity and rotate exposed real credentials.

rules.title: Potential detailed error disclosure
rules.description: An HTTP response appears to include a full error or debug representation. Server-only logging is not this check's target.
rules.remediation: Return a stable public error and correlation identifier; retain diagnostic details only in access-controlled server logs.
